subject.title: feat(android): accept audio and document attachments via share sheet and composer

question: Should Android ship generic document and ordinary-audio attachment intake only together with distinct history presentation, or should this PR be narrowed until that UX is intentionally designed?
rationale: The mechanical defects are repairable, but choosing the intended persistent chat representation for generic files versus voice notes is a user-facing Android product decision.

options.title: Complete generic attachment UX
options.body: Require filename-bearing document and ordinary-audio history rendering, resilient intake, and real-device proof before merging.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Defer generic audio/documents and retain only currently coherent image or voice-note attachment behavior until the Android history UX is designed.

recommendation.title: Complete generic attachment UX
recommendation.body: Require filename-bearing document and ordinary-audio history rendering, resilient intake, and real-device proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the active Android attachment series and is the strongest available routing candidate for the proposed UX boundary.
